contradictions_with_stored_summary: The library filename says 'Regulation_488_2014' but the PDF content is Commission Regulation (EU) 2021/1323 of 10 August 2021 (OJ L 288/13). The wiki record's identity (2021/1323) matches the content.
unresolved: The PDF text layer uses a shifted (Caesar +29) font encoding; text was decoded for reading (decoded copy not stored in AUDIT/primary). The '≥' symbols are lost in the decoded layer and were reconciled against the identical wording in Reg. 1881/2006 consolidated and Reg. 2023/915.
The cocoa rows were not changed by 2021/1323 (they originate in Reg. 488/2014, applicable from 1 January 2019); the 28 February 2022 sell-through date in Article 2 concerns foods whose MLs changed.
